title: 半導体工学
subtitle: Semiconductor Physics and Devices
keywords: Semiconductor Properties 2.Quantum Theory 3.Carrier Transport Mechanisms 4.Semiconductor Diode 5.Transistor
educationalGoal: Student will: (1) learn semiconductors properties in order to understand the operation mechanism of semiconductor devices.(2) learn pn junctions and metal-semiconductor contacts using the energy band theory studied on “Physical Electronics”. Those are basics on various devices. (3) learn structures and operation mechanism of various diodes, bipolar transistor (PNP , NPN), and field effective transistor (FET).
advice: Using knowledge of the energy band theory and semiconductor fundamental properties studied in “Physical Electronics”, students will learn other aspects of semiconductor fundamental properties. Students will also learn operation mechanisms and characteristics of pn junctions, metal-semiconductor contacts, bipolar transistors, and field-effect transistors. We will cover the following materials: 1. Fundamentals of electronic properties of semiconductors 2. Transport mechanisms and spatial distribution formation of free carriers 3. Semiconductor diode 4. Transistor Students should be aware of the teacher's instructions in the class, because the detailed course schedules may change depending on the students' progress in understanding. Class materials will be distributed in advance via the e-syllabus.
books: Textbooks: None Reference books: None Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: Understanding and knowledge of “Electronic Engineering” and “Physical Electronics”. Basic physics and mathematics, especially differential equations.

activityGoals.body: Be able to outline the content of lectures on the quantum state of electrons regarding semiconductor crystals.
Be able to outline the electronic state of semiconductors under thermal equilibrium conditions.
Be able to outline transport mechanisms and spatial distribution formation of free carriers.
Be able to explain the rectifying properties of a pn junction diode based on the diffusion model.
Be able to outline the operating principles and characteristics of bipolar transistors and MOSFETs.
